purpose: Generate reusable diagnostic/remediation question banks for foundational readiness skills.
exactSkillPolicyDescription: A readiness diagnostic question must explicitly contain its intervention readinessSkillId in skillIds.
generationRules: Each question must have exactly one primary readinessSkillId.
The primary readinessSkillId must also appear in skillIds.
The question must not claim mastery of a prerequisite skill.
Diagnostic questions must test the named readiness skill directly.
Remediation questions may use the readiness skill plus its immediate prerequisite context.
Questions must be meaningfully different rather than numerical copies.
At least one basic diagnostic item must isolate the target skill.
Avoid combining several prerequisite skills in the first diagnostic item.
Do not use an unrelated skill merely because it shares a topic.
Each generated question must preserve topicId and conceptId.
Question IDs must be stable and unique.
Correct answers and explanations must be deterministic.
Common mistakes should describe likely learner errors.
Generated questions must remain compatible with the existing question-selection engine.
Generated questions must remain compatible with the existing learning pipeline.
Do not modify learner progress while generating content.
Do not modify readiness state while generating content.

diagnosticPolicy.insufficientCoverageBehavior: Return structured content-gap state; never substitute unrelated questions.
